title: On the resonant Carleson-Radon transform in all dimensions. The degree one resonant case
summary: In this paper, we provide the resolution of the degree one resonant case in all dimensions. Our main result reads as follows: for any dimension $D\geq 1$ set $\mathbf{X}(\mathbf{t})=(\mathbf{t},|\mathbf{t}|^2),\; \mathbf{t}\in\mathbb{R}^D$, and let $K(\mathbf{t})$ be any suitable translation invariant Calderón--Zygmund kernel.
